context: A teacher and student plan posters and flyers for the school festival
purpose: Teach: サンプル/チラシ/最低限/呼びかけ/アピール/パッケージ/ポスター/数多く

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化祭まで二週間だけど、宣伝のポスターはもう描き始めた？
lines.en: There are two weeks until the festival, but have you started drawing the promotional posters yet?
lines.style: Calm teacher-style question with gentle prompting tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 下書きはできてます。あと、配るチラシのサンプルも一枚作ってみました。
lines.en: The rough draft is done. I also tried making one sample of the flyer we'll hand out.
lines.style: Polite student reporting progress with mild pride

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 見せて。うん、色が地味かな。もっとうちのクラスの出し物をアピールしたいね。
lines.en: Let me see. Hmm, the colors are a bit plain. I'd like to appeal more strongly with our class's attraction.
lines.style: Constructive teacher feedback in a warm advisory tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ、目立つキャッチコピーを大きく入れて、来てねっていう呼びかけを足します。
lines.en: Then I'll add a big eye-catching slogan and include a call-out asking people to come.
lines.style: Eager teenage student offering quick design fixes

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいね。最低限、日時と場所と内容の三つは大きく書いてね。
lines.en: Good idea. At a minimum, make sure the date, place, and content are written in big letters.
lines.style: Practical teacher reminder with structured guidance

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかりました。それと、チラシとポスターをひとつのパッケージみたいに同じデザインで揃えようと思ってます。
lines.en: Got it. Also, I'm thinking of matching the flyer and poster designs as one unified package.
lines.style: Confident student proposing a coherent unified visual concept

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: センスあるね。校内には数多く貼る場所があるから、印刷の枚数も多めに見積もっておいて。
lines.en: You've got good sense. There are numerous spots to post them around school, so estimate plenty of copies.
lines.style: Encouraging teacher giving practical logistical advice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、明日には完成版を持ってきます！
lines.en: Yes, I'll bring the finished version tomorrow!
lines.style: Bright energetic student closing with firm commitment
